jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.description: Company Summary Statement PPL Electric Utilities delivers safe, reliable and affordable electricity to more than 1.4 million homes and businesses throughout its 29-county service territory in eastern and central Pennsylvania. Through smart investments and innovation, it has built one of the most advanced electric grids in the United States. And, with over a century of expertise, PPL Electric remains focused on continuing to build the utility of the future, today. Regularly ranking among the country’s best utility companies for reliability and customer satisfaction, PPL Electric has won numerous awards, including 30 J.D. Power Awards for providing top-quality service to residential and business customers. PPL Electric is a major employer and an active supporter of the communities it serves. Empowering employees, community members and initiatives across its service territory through volunteerism and investments in organizations that support education, sustainability, and wellbeing. Overview Responsible for managing a team of professionals to drive operational excellence initiatives across key functions aligned with business strategy and regulatory requirements. The role oversees assessments, validates findings, and benchmarks performance to identify improvement opportunities. The role guides development of recommendations, reviews business cases, and presents solutions to leadership. The role manages project execution, monitors progress, resolves issues, and drives continuous improvement through post-implementation reviews. Responsibilities Manage a team performing operational assessments for assigned business unit/function, leveraging both qualitative and quantitative analysis to identify inefficiencies, risks, and improvement opportunities across business units Review and validate findings from team members, ensuring accuracy and relevance to business objectives. Guide the team in developing actionable recommendations and innovative solutions for process optimization, technology enablement, and organizational change Lead benchmarking studies of operations against industry standards and best practices to inform improvement strategies. Review and refine business cases, ensuring robust financial analysis, risk assessment, and alignment with strategic priorities Present recommendations to senior management and stakeholders, advocating for adoption and investment. Partner with senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to align priorities and drive execution Oversee the execution of high impact improvement projects, ensuring adherence to timelines, budgets, and quality standards. Monitor project milestones, resolve escalated issues, and manage risks to ensure successful delivery Conduct post-implementation reviews, identify lessons learned, and drive further optimization based on results Lead cross-functional alignment and change management initiatives, including stakeholder engagement, executive communication, and enterprise-wide adoption strategies Promote adoption of new processes, tools, and ways of working across the organization, ensuring alignment with governance frameworks, compliance standards, and long-term sustainability Qualifications Education: Bachelor's Degree in Business, Operations, Engineering or any other related discipline is required. Master's Degree is preferred. Experience: 5+ years of relevant experience in business operations, process improvement, qualitative research or a related field is required. Industry experience is preferred. Certifications/Licenses: • Certified in Lean and/or Six Sigma or equivalent (Preferred)

jobs.title: Energy Efficiency - Demand Response Program Manager
jobs.description: Company Summary Statement PPL Electric Utilities delivers safe, reliable and affordable electricity to more than 1.4 million homes and businesses throughout its 29-county service territory in eastern and central Pennsylvania. Through smart investments and innovation, it has built one of the most advanced electric grids in the United States. And, with over a century of expertise, PPL Electric remains focused on continuing to build the utility of the future, today. Regularly ranking among the country’s best utility companies for reliability and customer satisfaction, PPL Electric has won numerous awards, including 30 J.D. Power Awards for providing top-quality service to residential and business customers. PPL Electric is a major employer and an active supporter of the communities it serves. Empowering employees, community members and initiatives across its service territory through volunteerism and investments in organizations that support education, sustainability, and wellbeing. Overview This position is responsible to design, implement, and manage large, multiple, and highly complex energy efficiency and demand response programs for PPL Electric Utilities' residential, low-income, and non-residential customers. These programs help customers save money, increase customer satisfaction, create and maintain a positive image for the company, and allow the company to achieve its business and regulatory objectives for energy efficiency and demand response. Could also be responsible for other customer-facing programs such as for electric vehicles, electrification, and distributed energy resources. Responsibilities Design, implement, deliver, and manage one or more of the Company's energy efficiency and demand response programs to cost-effectively meet the needs of customers, assure high customer satisfaction, and meet all business and regulatory objectives such as energy savings, peak load reductions, and cost objectives. Manage an annual budget of approximately $5 to $25 million. Manage a cross functional team of internal/external partners to design and implement energy efficiency/DSM programs within their specified scope, schedule, and budget. Identify, develop, coordinate, negotiate, and manage contracts to successfully implement the programs. Assist in planning and developing the multi-year Energy Efficiency/DSM plan. Assist in the development of marketing/advertising plans and creative content to ensure the marketing, advertising, communication, website, trade ally networks, and other outreach will achieve desired program performance. Request, coordinate, and ensure market research and other analyses are completed to identify potential program participants, to confirm program goals are reasonably attainable, to ensure program-specific marketing is effective, to continuously improve program performance and customer satisfaction, to anticipate and understand market trends and best practices, and for other purposes related to energy efficiency/DSM programs. Design, implement, and manage program performance metrics, key leading/lagging indicators, QA/QC, reports, and other business processes and controls to accurately monitor, forecast, and control program performance (cost, schedule, energy savings, customer satisfaction, etc.). Ensure the program captures the information required by regulators, evaluators, and the company to document customer and program eligibility, to document and calculate savings, and to ensure costs and savings are correctly allocated to customer sectors and programs. May supervise program support personnel Performs other duties as assigned Complies with all policies and standards Qualifications Required Education: Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, communications, engineering, or technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience on a year for year basis Required Experience: 5+ years’ experience and strong knowledge of energy efficiency/DSM programs, or electric or gas utility experience, or the development, deployment, and management of energy related products and services. Working knowledge of energy efficiency program best practices, evaluation, and cost-effectiveness. Knowledge of residential and commercial/industrial building systems, equipment, and processes as they relate to energy usage/efficiency. Knowledge of market partners and channels for successful delivery of energy efficiency programs, equipment, and technology. Excellent leadership, interpersonal, communication, public speaking, customer service, and project/program management skills. Proficiency in the use of word processing and spreadsheet software. Established analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills. Preferred Qualifications: MBA or other graduate degrees including business, marketing, communications, or technical discipline. 5+ years in the development, deployment, and management of energy related products, services, and/or customer communication programs. Proven experience in the development of products, services, program strategy plans, or communication strategies. Experience in the development of budgets and high-level financial plans.

jobs.title: Strategic Finance Analyst
jobs.description: Company Summary Statement As one of the largest investor-owned utility companies in the United States, PPL Corporation (NYSE: PPL), is committed to creating long-term, sustainable value for our 3.5 million customers, our shareowners and the communities we serve. Our high-performing regulated utilities — PPL Electric Utilities, Louisville Gas and Electric, Kentucky Utilities and Rhode Island Energy — provide an outstanding experience for our customers, consistently ranking among the best utilities in the nation. PPL’s companies are also addressing challenges head-on by investing in new infrastructure and technology that is creating a smarter, more reliable and resilient energy grid. We are committed to doing our part to advance a cleaner energy future and drive innovation that enables us to achieve net-zero carbon emissions by 2050 while maintaining energy reliability and affordability for the customers and communities we serve. PPL is a positive force in the cities and towns where we do business, providing support for programs and organizations that empower the success of future generations by helping to build and maintain strong, diverse communities today. Overview The Strategic Finance Analyst serves as a key financial partner to the business, responsible for evaluating strategic development opportunities, driving financial planning and analysis, and delivering actionable insights through ad hoc analysis. This role bridges the gap between financial data and business strategy, enabling leadership to make informed, data-driven decisions that support PPL’s corporate goals. Responsibilities Requirements Build and maintain complex financial models to support scenario planning, sensitivity analysis, and business performance evaluation. Support the execution of M&A transactions, including due diligence, data room management, and interaction with counterparties. Evaluate organic and external growth opportunities through the creation of discounted cash flow models to support strategic decision making. Automate existing processes to improve timeliness and accuracy of financial data. Develop original financial analysis to provide new insights into corporate performance. Conduct in-depth industry research and competitive benchmarking to identify market trends and strategic opportunities. Prepare executive-level financial reports, dashboards, and commentary for leadership and board-level reviews. Develop and maintain strong relationships with personnel from PPL's business lines and other corporate support group functions. Analyze and prepare monthly and quarterly reports as requested by management. Perform other duties as assigned. Comply with all policies and standards. Qualifications Qualifications - Strategic Finance Analyst Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or a related field. 2+ years of finance or related experience. Preferred Qualifications CFA or CPA. Power and utility experience. Master's degree in Finance or Accounting. Intermediate knowledge of Excel. Strong attention to detail and time management skills. Capacity to perform analysis while understanding big-picture implications and willingness to solve problems. Self-starter with a natural sense of urgency, curiosity, and initiative. Qualifications - Senior Strategic Finance Analyst Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or a related field. 5 years of finance or related experience. Preferred Qualifications Power and utility experience. Master's degree in Finance or Accounting. CFA or CPA. Intermediate knowledge of Excel. Strong attention to detail and time management skills.

jobs.title: Manager, Finance Business Partner - IT & Innovation
jobs.description: Company Summary Statement As one of the largest investor-owned utility companies in the United States, PPL Corporation (NYSE: PPL), is committed to creating long-term, sustainable value for our 3.5 million customers, our shareowners and the communities we serve. Our high-performing regulated utilities — PPL Electric Utilities, Louisville Gas and Electric, Kentucky Utilities and Rhode Island Energy — provide an outstanding experience for our customers, consistently ranking among the best utilities in the nation. PPL’s companies are also addressing challenges head-on by investing in new infrastructure and technology that is creating a smarter, more reliable and resilient energy grid. We are committed to doing our part to advance a cleaner energy future and drive innovation that enables us to achieve net-zero carbon emissions by 2050 while maintaining energy reliability and affordability for the customers and communities we serve. PPL is a positive force in the cities and towns where we do business, providing support for programs and organizations that empower the success of future generations by helping to build and maintain strong, diverse communities today. Overview The Manager – Finance Business Partner, IT and Innovation is responsible for finance business partnering for the IT and Innovation function, with support for the IT Customer and Next Gen Value Streams. This role supports senior management planning and decision-making by providing consolidated financial forecasts, scenario projections, multi-year budgets, monthly forecasts, and budget variance reporting. The position also provides critical support for rate case activities across jurisdictions, partners with PPL Services on intercompany allocations, leads process improvements, and provides financial leadership and guidance to the team. These are all hybrid opportunities that can be worked in the following market segments PA, KY and RI #LI-Hy Responsibilities Plan and manage consolidated capital and O&M multi-year budgets and monthly forecasts for the IT and Innovation function and by jurisdiction. Partner with IT and Innovation senior leadership and management teams to coordinate departmental goals, objectives, operating budgets, and forecasts. Compile, maintain, and analyze budgetary and financial data; coordinate budgetary and statistical analyses. Provide rate case filing schedules and support for all jurisdictions, including support for data requests and testimony related to consolidated capital and O&M. Perform system administration responsibilities for the Kentucky core budgeting platform, including updating monthly actuals. Coordinate and prepare monthly performance reports, consolidated capital and O&M budget/forecast reports, and departmental TMO updates. Coordinate and review documentation for capital and O&M RAC committees, ensuring projects align with PPL’s capital policy. Align IT financial processes using lean budgeting principles as PPL’s integration of SAFe advances. Coordinate and review IT and Innovation intercompany charges, including investigating charges and allocations. Serve as a subject matter expert for budgeting systems, including training junior employees, retrieving and displaying budget/forecast information, modifying standard reports, creating ad hoc reports, and leading system upgrades or testing as needed. Lead special projects identified by management. Maintain a thorough working knowledge of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and provide FERC classification of accounts guidance. Maintain strong interpersonal skills for ongoing interaction with and presentation to all levels of management and administrative staff. Develop staff to maximize their potential within PPL. Perform all other duties as assigned. Qualifications Required Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, management, economics, marketing, or a related field. Minimum of seven years of experience in a finance-related field. Preferred Qualifications: Advanced degree such as an MBA. CPA or CGMA certification. Knowledge of or experience in the energy or power industry. Knowledge of lean budgeting and SAFe principles. Attendance, Work Conditions, Physical Effort, and Job Hazards Regular attendance is essential for satisfactory performance. Normal office environment with remote work flexibility. Primarily sitting with optional standing, stretching, and walking. Low degree of physical hazards associated with the position.
